name: Diamond DA20 Katana / Eclipse
summary: Two-seat composite trainer with a T-tail and bubble canopy, used for primary training and by the US Air Force Academy for screening.

engines: Single small engine in a slim cowl
fuselage: Two-seat side-by-side cockpit under a large bubble canopy
Fixed tricycle gear with spring main legs and wheel pants

tellTales: Small two-seat composite trainer with a T-tail
Large bubble canopy and very slim tail boom
Long thin wing like a motor glider

confusedWith.howToTell: The DA40 has a longer four-seat cabin with rear windows; the DA20 is a short two-seater.
The 150/152 is a strut-braced metal high-wing; the DA20 is a low-wing composite with a T-tail.
The AA-1/AA-5 has a conventional low tail and stubby wing; the DA20 has a T-tail and long slender wing.
The DA20 is a lower, rounder composite with a longer glazed canopy; the P-Mentor has an upright fin, a straighter wing and an alloy-and-carbon look.
The Firefly has a larger bubble canopy and fixed tricycle gear with fairings; the DA20 has a rounder canopy and a distinct tail shape.
The DA20 is a composite with a conventional tail and a clear bubble canopy; the Tomahawk is metal with a T-tail and a framed cabin.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
